name: Speed of Closure
definition: The ability to quickly make sense of, combine, and organize information into meaningful patterns.

benchmark.name: ARC
benchmark.model_or_system: icecuber (Johan Sokrates Wind), a program search over a hand-written domain-specific language (DSL)
benchmark.metric: percent of private evaluation tasks solved (top-3 attempts)
benchmark.human_reference: General adult population (typical working adults, no specialist training), since Speed of Closure is a broad perceptual-cognitive ability

benchmark.name: ARC
benchmark.model_or_system: Icecuber (Johan Sokrates Wind) - DSL-based brute-force program search
benchmark.metric: percent of hidden private-test tasks solved (top-3 attempts, Kaggle ARC 2020 protocol)
benchmark.human_reference: General adult population (ARC tasks need no specialist knowledge; Speed of Closure is a general cognitive ability used across many jobs)

benchmark.name: ARC
benchmark.model_or_system: Team SM (Somayyeh Gholami & Mehran Kazeminia) and Team MindsAI (Jack Cole), tied for first
benchmark.metric: percent of private test-set tasks solved (top-3 attempts per task)
benchmark.human_reference: General adult population (untrained adults solving novel visual pattern-induction puzzles). No specialist workforce exists for this ability.

benchmark.name: ARC-AGI
benchmark.metric: percent of tasks solved (accuracy), ARC-AGI-1 Semi-Private Evaluation set (100 tasks)
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce: typical working adults doing novel visual pattern-organization tasks, not STEM-selected puzzle experts

benchmark.name: ARC-AGI-2
benchmark.human_reference: General adult working population. ARC-AGI-2 was calibrated on paid members of the public with no specialist training, which suits a broad cognitive ability like Speed of Closure.

benchmark.name: ARC-AGI-3
benchmark.metric: percent (ARC-AGI-3 Semi-Private score, based on Relative Human Action Efficiency)
benchmark.human_reference: General adult population (the ARC Prize human baseline comes from about 500 members of the general public). Speed of Closure is a broad cognitive ability, not a specialist skill.
